newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's Corinthia buys century-old Budapest hotel.
newsitem.headline: Malta's Corinthia buys century-old Budapest hotel.

text.p: Malta's Corinthia Hotels Group said on Wednesday it had bought the century-old Royal Hotel, its second five-star hotel acquisition in four months in Budapest, Hungary.

The hotel is the 12th property in the Corinthia chain and its second city centre hotel, the other being the five star Aqvincvm Corinthia Hotel on the banks of the River Danube in the Hungarian capital.
The chain also has hotels in Malta, Turkey and Tunisia.

Group chairman Alfred Pisani did not reveal the purchase price but said the acquisition "reaffirms the group's strong belief in Hungary's potential as a fast emerging holiday and business destination."

The Budapest hotel opened in April 1896 as the Hotel Royal and closed in 1991. The Corinthia Group will retain the facade but demolish the rest, rebuilding it as a luxury 350-room property including a conference room for 1,000 delegates and a health centre. It will be known as the Royal Corinthia, it said.
